title: Subject buckets anchored to the LC headings of the books we cite
approvedBy: curator (2026-11-19: "create subject buckets"), placements drafted by Claude
purpose: Buckets (28) for the LC subject headings the cited books carry that no Subject held: each anchored to its heading (subject_access), about its focus Entities where they exist, placed under the Roman Republic backbone. Members are computed from claims (28 §3), never stored.
scope: Headings with an LC record only. Left out: Naval battles (generic: it would sweep every sea fight into one bucket, 28 §5); Rome--Officials and employees (LC's broader term for Magistrates, Roman, and wider than the Republic); headings LC has no record of (Relations with women, Mauretania (Kingdom)--Civilization).

subjects.label: Civil War, 43-31 B.C.
subjects.reviewNote: LC's span (43-31 B.C.) covers the Liberators' war and the final war: Philippi and Actium are its campaigns.

subjects.label: Rome under Augustus, 30 B.C.-14 A.D.
subjects.reviewNote: LC's period heading for the reign; Syme's Augustan Aristocracy carries it.

subjects.label: Roman magistrates
subjects.reviewNote: Broughton's subject. No single focus: its members are the Offices people held.
